sources.title: Haotian Tan | Academic Homepage
sources.snippet: Haotian Tan is a Ph.D. candidate in Information Science at the Nara Institute of Science and Technology (NAIST), where he is a member of the Human AI Interaction Laboratory under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Sakriani Sakti. His research focuses on simultaneous speech translation and real-time spoken language systems.

sources.title: PDF NAIST Simultaneous Speech Translation System for IWSLT 2025
sources.snippet: Abstract This paper describes the NAIST submission to the English-to-{German, Japanese, Chinese} Simultaneous Speech-to-Text track at IWSLT 2025. Last year, our system was based on an end-to-end speech-to-text translation model that combined HuBERT and mBART.
